footnotes.text: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

evidence.quote: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.50 GPA on all MUSC & MUED courses and a 2.00 cumulative GPA.

footnotes.text: 2. Some colleges require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

evidence.quote: 2. Some colleges require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

footnotes.text: 3. Students are required to participate in the major ensemble most closely related to their primary instrument. Students must declare a primary instrument upon acceptance into the program. Some ensembles require an audition for membership. Regulations for attendance at ensemble rehearsals & performances are different from regulations for class attendance. Members of ensembles are expected to be present at every rehearsal & performance, unless excused by the conductor. Courses which qualify for the Chamber Music requirement include all MUSC 130 courses with a suffix of A-Z and topics in: Voice, String, Percussion, Wind, Guitar, and Keyboard. Students enrolling in an ensemble to fulfill a degree requirement must register for at least 1 credit hour. Ensemble requirements are (in semesters): a. Guitar: 2 major (usually choral), 6 guitar ensembles b. Jazz: 6 jazz ensembles, 2 major or minor jazz ensembles c. Organ: 4 major (usually choral), 4 accompanying d. Piano: 2 major, 2 accompanying, 2 chamber, 2 of choice e. String: 6 orchestra, 2 chamber f. Voice: 6 major, 2 opera workshop g. Wind/Percussion: 6 major, 2 chamber

footnotes.text: 4. MUED 155 and 156 are not required if taking MUSC 211P for Piano as primary instrument or if a student passes the proficiency exam.

footnotes.text: 5. Applied Music must be completed satisfactorily for a minimum of 8 semesters & 32 hours of credit.

evidence.quote: 5. Applied Music must be completed satisfactorily for a minimum of 8 semesters & 32 hours of credit.

footnotes.text: 6. Students in the Performance concentration are required to demonstrate proficiency in one foreign language equivalent to the 122 course through course credit or the corresponding foreign language placement score.

footnotes.text: 7. The Carolina Core provides the common core of knowledge, skill and academic experience for all Carolina undergraduate students.

evidence.quote: 7. The Carolina Core provides the common core of knowledge, skill and academic experience for all Carolina undergraduate students.

footnotes.text: 9. Music History and Literature Electives (6 hours): MUSC 500, 523, 526, 528, 543, 544, 545, 548, 549, 555, 557, 558, 559, and 587.

evidence.quote: 9. Music History and Literature Electives (6 hours): MUSC 500, 523, 526, 528, 543, 544, 545, 548, 549, 555, 557, 558, 559, and 587.

footnotes.text: 10. Concentration Electives: Any MUED or MUSC courses (other than MUSC 103, 104, 105, 110, 113, 140, 203). Students must complete a pedagogy course in applied area when available. Students must complete a minimum of 13 hours of concentration electives, including MUED 155 & 156, if needed. Students whose primary medium is voice must complete MUSC 570, 578, and 579. Students whose primary instrument is piano must complete MUSC 573, 573L, 574, 574L. Students whose primary instrument is guitar must complete MUSC 573 and 587.
